pathAllocationPolicy: eight declarative ShapePaths with retained PathMultiline opacity buckets
rationale: A render-proven declarative ShapePath/PathMultiline renderer produced connection pixels with geometry overlapping 99.93% of the smaller Canvas mask, then used substantially less CPU and RSS than equivalent visible immediate Canvas painting in every default and maximum one-output and three-output comparison on Qt 6.11.1 and Quickshell 0.3.0.
